items.title: HackMe OS 0.1.0-rc11l — live USB overlay boot fix
items.summary: Live USB on laptops panicked with overlay not loaded: casper live boot never runs local-premount. rc11l loads kernel modules in casper-premount before the squashfs mounts. Windows and Linux installers unchanged; download channel is rc11l.
items.impact: Use HackMe-OS-0.1.0-rc11l-amd64.iso only for USB rigs until hardware sign-off.

telegram.headline: HackMe OS rc11l — live USB boot fix
telegram.lead: Some laptops hit an initramfs overlay panic: the loader script was in local-premount, but live casper never runs that phase.
bullets: rc11l loads overlay modules in casper-premount, before the live root mounts.
Download channel: 0.1.0-rc11l (same Windows/Linux builds, new ISO).
Verify SHA256 on the downloads page before flashing.
telegram.footer: Flash the whole disk (Etcher or dd). In GRUB pick “HackMe OS (live — recommended)”.
